ValidationRule.description: If a Task is assigned to the Custodian Submittal Queue, or the Task Template indicates it will be assigned there, only members of the Custodian Submittal Queue can change the status to Completed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Completed"), NOT($Permission.Custodian_Submittal_Task_Approval), OR( Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = "Custodian_Submittal", Task_Template_Queue__c = "Custodian Submittal" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This task is (or is set to be) assigned to the Custodian Submittal Queue. Only Custodian Submittal Queue members can set the status to Completed.
